svg.title: The apparent benefit of recognizing already-seen groups
svg.desc: Accuracy of three transparent baselines under matched 240-row training sets and identical 40-case balanced test data. Eight stable synthetic fingerprint features contain no population outcome signal but identify groups when another visit is present. Bars are one deterministic teaching realization, not confidence intervals or clinical evidence.
